description_en: Modifies information about an access configuration
description_zh: 调用UpdateAccessConfiguration修改访问配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso update-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAccessConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the access configuration.

The description can be up to 1,024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
新的访问配置描述。

长度：最大1024个字符
parameters.name: new_description

parameters.help_en:
The new duration of a session

in which a CloudSSO user accesses an account in your resource directory by using the access configuration.

Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 900 to 43200. The value 900 indicates 15 minutes. The value 43200 indicates 12 hours
parameters.help_zh:
新的会话持续时间。

云SSO用户使用访问配置访问RD账号时，会话最多保持的时间。

单位：秒。

取值范围：900~43200（15分钟~12小时）
parameters.name: new_session_duration

parameters.help_en:
The new initial web page

that is displayed after a CloudSSO user accesses an account in your resource directory by using the access configuration.

The web page must be a page of the Alibaba Cloud Management Console
parameters.help_zh:
新的初始访问页面。

云SSO用户使用访问配置访问RD账号时，初始访问的页面地址。

该页面必须是阿里云控制台页面
parameters.name: new_relay_state

AccessConfiguration.description_en: The information about the access configuration

AccessConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the access configuration

AccessConfigurationName.description_en: The name of the access configuration

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the access configuration was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 访问配置的创建时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Description.description_en: The description of the access configuration

RelayState.description_en:
The initial web page

that is displayed after a CloudSSO user accesses an account in your resource directory by using the access configuration
RelayState.description_zh:
初始访问页面。

云SSO用户使用访问配置访问RD账号时，初始访问的页面地址

SessionDuration.description_en:
The duration of a session

in which a CloudSSO user accesses an account in your resource directory by using the access configuration.

Unit: seconds
SessionDuration.description_zh:
会话持续时间。

云SSO用户使用访问配置访问RD账号时，会话最多保持的时间。

单位：秒

items.description_en:
The status notification. Valid values:

Empty: No status notifications are sent.

ReprovisionRequired: The access configuration needs to be re-provisioned
items.description_zh:
状态通知信息。取值：

空：表示没有状态通知信息。
ReprovisionRequired：表示该访问配置需要重新部署

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the information about the access configuration was modified
UpdateTime.description_zh: 访问配置的修改时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）
